Questions

Can tenants pay rent through the website?

Tenant actions link to your existing AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, or other service. These are links to your systems; custom integrations require a separate scope.

Who keeps the availability current?

Before launch, we define who sends availability and tenant changes, what we update, and the expected response time.

Can you move our existing content?

Yes. Content migration is part of the scope we propose.

Can you photograph our properties?

Yes, quoted separately. See property photography.
